name: @kit/peeps-creator
description: Assembly: a character creator for @kit/peeps (and the whole figures of @kit/transhumans, and the things of @kit/things in a scene) as one React component (<PeepCreator />): part picker with a dice per tab, colours, transparent background, scale/rotate/flip, undo, themes, SVG and PNG export. Drops into a page or a dashboard panel.
